lines.zh: 我走三步，停一步，看距离。
lines.en: I walk three steps, halt one, check the range.
Runandor's ground floats in the air.
I walk along the edges of stone platforms.
My steps are light; my eyes are not.

lines.zh: 我后退，是为了拉开距离。
lines.en: I step back to open the distance.

lines.zh: 我跟你的距离要停在十步。
lines.en: The gap between us must stay at ten paces.
Runes whisper under the soles of my boots.
I crossed the bridge and it did not sway.
I step around your front, never through it.
Every step already includes my way out.
I walk while nocking an arrow to the string.
Distance is my real weapon.
I count the floating stones beneath me.
The string slackened; I tightened it back.
The wind in Runandor has no direction.
I wiped the arrowhead three times.

lines.zh: 远处有东西在光里移动。
lines.en: Something moves out there in the light.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一根立在台上的箭。
lines.en: I stand like an arrow stuck in a pedestal.
The lapis at my belt stays cold.
I am listening to the string's echo.
The day is long; I can wait.

lines.zh: 手不抖，是因为我站得稳。
lines.en: My hands do not shake because my feet do not.

lines.zh: 我先看你的手，再看你的眼。
lines.en: I check your hands first, then your eyes.
You are standing at the edge of my range.

lines.zh: 你往前一步，我就退一步。
lines.en: One step forward from you, one back from me.
Your shoulders are broad, a fine target.
I can tell you carry a shield.

lines.zh: 你在估算我拉弓要多久。
lines.en: You are estimating how long I need to draw.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在数你的心跳。
lines.en: My eyes are counting your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 你身上有青金石的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of lapis on you.

lines.zh: 别以为我没看见你的同伴。
lines.en: Do not think I missed your companion.

lines.zh: 你看得太久，位置就暴露了。
lines.en: You have looked too long; your spot is known.

lines.zh: 我在等你露出一点破绽。
lines.en: I wait for you to show one gap.

lines.zh: 你和我之间，隔着一段好距离。
lines.en: Between us lies a very comfortable distance.
The arrow went wide because you moved first.
It hurts, but the string is still mine.

lines.zh: 这一下我从台上退了一步。
lines.en: That blow pushed me one step back.
You closed the distance, which favors you.
I shift position and keep aiming.
The arrowhead chipped; it still works.
I set my teeth and draw to full again.
I am surprised you actually hit me.
One hundred nine, and far from finished.
Blood drips on the bow; I wipe it off.
Do not offer runes in exchange for your life.
My arrows are not for sale or for gifts.

lines.zh: 青金石我有，不需要你的。
lines.en: I have lapis; I need none of yours.
You raise a hand; I raise my bow.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，我不弯腰。
lines.en: I do not bend for things dropped on the ground.
I am not greedy; I guard my distance.

lines.zh: 你晃的符纸，我看得太多了。
lines.en: I have seen too many rune papers waved at me.
Put it away before I shoot through it.

lines.zh: 你用财宝换不来我的位置。
lines.en: Treasure will not buy my position from me.

lines.zh: 我想要的，只是你别再靠近。
lines.en: All I want is for you to come no closer.
Bumping me, do you want to shorten the range?
Back off; you are inside my dead zone.
I dislike anyone standing against me.
This close, my bow becomes useless.
I blocked it with the limb of my bow.
Do not shove; I will not give ground.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸吹到我脸上了。
lines.en: Your breath is reaching my face.
One more step back and I leave the edge.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我用手也能打。
lines.en: At this range, my hands will do.
Touch me and you owe me an arrow.

lines.zh: 守护者之间只交换眼神。
lines.en: Guardians exchange only glances.
We have no home, only posts.

lines.zh: 她也站在另一座浮台上。
lines.en: She stands on another floating platform.

lines.zh: 符境没有婚礼，只有值守。
lines.en: Runandor has no weddings, only watches.

lines.zh: 我们隔着很远也能认出彼此。
lines.en: We know each other across great distance.
Sharing a night watch counts as closeness.
I have no gentle words to say.
I split my arrows with her.
Any child of ours will draw a bow.
She shoots a little straighter than I do.
An arrow fell; I pick it back up.
I flip the lapis up with my toe.
A pebble dropped into my quiver.
Anything useful, I gather it.

lines.zh: 你的盾牌碎片，我留一块。
lines.en: I keep one shard of your broken shield.
I do not pick up another's weapon.
Runes must be laid out one by one.
This is light; it works as a counterweight.
I bend once and pick up one thing.

lines.zh: 掉在射程里的，都是我的。
lines.en: What falls inside my range is mine.
You entered my range; I begin.
First I note how fast you move.
Thirteen and a half, enough to pierce leather.
You are still looking for where I stand.
The rune points at your chest.
Do not run straight; my aim is true.
This platform is under my watch.
You stepped on stone you should not touch.
My arrow acknowledges only one target.

lines.zh: 你已经被我量过三次了。
lines.en: I have measured you three times already.
Good, the range is right and the wind agrees.

lines.zh: 你的第一击，我记在弦上。
lines.en: I keep your first strike on the string.
Runandor has one more intruder.

lines.zh: 别躲柱后，我的箭会拐弯。
lines.en: Do not hide behind the pillar; my arrow bends.
I draw to full and wait for you to look up.

lines.zh: 你每动一步，我修正一点。
lines.en: Every step you take corrects me slightly.

lines.zh: 我算好了你落脚的石头。
lines.en: I have worked out which stone you will step on.
Do not charge yet; think about the angle.
I hold my breath so the string stays still.

lines.zh: 你左边的空地，是个陷阱。
lines.en: The open ground to your left is a trap.
The string hums like a tightening thread.
Back away and I change platforms.
I am waiting for that one step.
Your shield cannot stop a lobbed shot.
My sight rests against your throat.
Stay still; moving makes it worse.
At this distance I could shoot blind.
I have already taken my position.

lines.zh: 我把符文贴上箭杆，光就顺了。
lines.en: I press a rune to the shaft and the light steadies.

lines.zh: 这一箭，从你的护甲缝进去。
lines.en: This arrow goes in through your armor gap.
Did you hear the air tear?
That arrow by your foot was a warning.
The second arrow will not announce itself.

lines.zh: 我一箭一箭地数你的命。
lines.en: I count your life away one arrow at a time.
Do not pull it out; the head is barbed.
You dodge once; I change my angle.
Thirteen and a half, right on your shoulder.
Even my bow's tip can draw blood.

lines.zh: 这一箭擦着你的耳朵过去。
lines.en: This one grazed past your ear.
Standing still was a poor choice.

lines.zh: 箭从高处的平台上来的。
lines.en: The arrow came down from the high platform.
I do not hesitate when I loose.

lines.zh: 最后一箭，我留给你转身。
lines.en: The last arrow I save for when you turn.

lines.zh: 你冲到台前，我拿箭尾刺你。
lines.en: Reach the platform and I stab with the arrow's tail.

lines.zh: 这一箭打在你的盾沿，弹开了。
lines.en: This one hits your shield rim and glances off.

lines.zh: 我从符文的裂口里走出来。
lines.en: I step out of a tear in the runes.
The bow is already strung.

lines.zh: 我第一次看符境的天空。
lines.en: I look at the Runandor sky for the first time.
The platform under me holds firm.

lines.zh: 我的职责从这一刻开始。
lines.en: My duty begins at this moment.

lines.zh: 远处已有脚步，我先站定。
lines.en: Footsteps already sound far off; I take my post.
I tested the string; it sounds tight.
My quiver is full of runes.
I stand in the light, not hiding.
This place needs someone to watch it.
I hang the lapis at my waist.
My first draw is steady in the hand.

lines.zh: 火把符境的空气烧红了。
lines.en: Fire turns the Runandor air red.
The platform was too narrow; I fell.
Swimming is not something I learned.
The blast swept me off the platform.
Your arrow was a little faster than mine.
The runes rattle wildly inside me.
Hunger is making my stance waver.
Lightning numbed my bowstring through my hand.
The platform is gone; I fall.
